close_reason: Rewrote try_find_cert_ext doc to prominently label it fail-closed and clarify the distinction from find_cert_ext.
description: find_cert_ext and try_find_cert_ext differ only by the generic try_ prefix, which signals fallibility without explaining why two variants exist. The real distinction is fail-open (silently treat decode error as absent) vs fail-closed (propagate decode error). Suggested: rename try_find_cert_ext to find_cert_ext_strict, or make one function returning Result<Option<T>> and let find_cert_ext call .ok().flatten(). Either makes the semantic choice visible at the call site rather than requiring the reader to look up both implementations.
title: try_find_cert_ext: name does not signal fail-open vs fail-closed
